fit.figure: Electrical characteristics (no typical DC curve on the sheet)
fit.method: Idss the geometric middle of 2-20 mA (6.32 mA); VGS at 0.2 mA the middle of -0.5 to -7.5 V (-1.94 V), so Vp -2.36 V (square law); BETA = Idss/Vp²; CGD = Crss 3 pF, CGS = Ciss − Crss = 4 pF (the sheet's maxima: it gives no typicals); no LAMBDA (the sheet gives output conductance only at 100 MHz)
fit.note: Real units spread over the sheet's whole range; a circuit's measured Idss and Vp replace these (D-130)
